pages.title: What Is Cooldown?
pages.text: Each shot consumes ammunition and also generates heat. A weapon cannot fire again until sufficiently cooled. Its heat is displayed beside its abbreviation on the Control Seat HUD; see $(l:vsie:weapon/weapon_channel)Weapons: Channels/$ and $(l:vsie:control_seat/flying_information)Control Seat: HUD/$.$(br2)AeroIE weapons use one of two cooldown models:

pages.title: Single-Shot Cooldown
pages.text: These weapons generate heat much faster than they dissipate it. Every shot therefore causes an overheat, and the weapon must cool completely before firing again.

pages.title: Sustained-Fire Cooldown
pages.text: These weapons can fire repeatedly. Each shot adds some heat, which gradually dissipates while the weapon is not firing.
